objective: Strengthen ledger behavioral discrimination (C42.21: 190 generated, 108 killed, 82 survived, 56.8%).
strategic_constraint: Strengthen genuine behavioral gaps only; do NOT add tests that assert implementation-internal dict keys/output literals merely to kill mutants.

current_full_local_run.note: Identical to C42.21 baseline — population and result stable.

approach: Analyzed all 82 survivors. The reachable behavioral contract (status PASS/FAIL logic, hash tamper detection, run_full_audit overall_status) is already exercised by the existing 25-test suite (which is why 108 mutants are killed). No new tests were added because the remaining survivors are NOT genuine behavioral gaps.

examples: row["id"] -> row["ID"] (column-name literal never produced by SQLite)
class_C_unreachable_literal.rationale: Mutations substitute string literals (dict keys, column names, violation-type strings) that no caller or SQLite result row ever produces. Unreachable under the contract. A test asserting these exact internal literals would be an anti-gaming 'assertion derived from implementation internals' and was NOT added.

examples: message f-string wording changes (e.g., 'null or empty' -> 'NULL or empty')
violation message formatting that yields identical observable status
class_B_equivalent.rationale: Human-readable message text mutations that do not change the detection outcome (status/type/severity). Equivalent for valid-domain behavior.

survivor_classification.genuine_gaps_remaining: None. The NEGATIVE_DEBIT / NEGATIVE_CREDIT / DUAL_ENTRY SQL checks are defensive (debit/credit are GENERATED ALWAYS AS columns from type+amount_paise and cannot be negative/cross via the application), and their status-logic is already covered.

validation.regression: Existing ledger_audit suite (25 tests) remains green.
validation.targeted_mutation: Full 190-mutant local run completed: 108 killed / 82 survived (identical to C42.21).

exit_gate.high_value_behavioral_tests_implemented: N/A — no genuine Class-A gap found; reachable contract already covered (no redundant tests added, per anti-gaming controls)
exit_gate.meaningful_mutation_improvements_evidenc: Stable at 56.8%; remaining 82 survivors classified as Class B/C (no genuine gap)
